ns2:course.label: Logic and Reasoning QR II
ns2:course.description: Introductory logic course that concentrates on investigating how the formal mathematical structure of statements, as well as the structure of the relationships among such statements, reveals the logical force of arguments that we use everyday. PHIL 102 takes a less formal, less mathematical approach to the same material. Students may not receive credit for both PHIL 103 and PHIL 102.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and Quant Reasoning II course.
